candidates.title: Out of the Memory Barrier: A Highly Memory Efficient Training System for LLMs with Million-Token Contexts
candidates.reason: Long-context training system combining O(1) activation-memory chunk recurrence, paged KV/gradient management, asynchronous CPU offload, and sparse attention; directly relevant to hierarchical-memory training.

candidates.title: ProTrain: Efficient LLM Training via Memory-Aware Techniques
candidates.reason: Adaptive heterogeneous training system coordinating model-state memory, activation memory, computation and I/O using runtime profiling, with reported 1.43x-2.71x throughput gains.

candidates.title: LuWu: An End-to-End In-Network Out-of-Core Optimizer for 100B-Scale Model-in-Network Data-Parallel Training on Distributed GPUs
candidates.reason: Moves optimizer state/parameters and collective communication off GPU workers into an in-network optimizer design, directly addressing out-of-core training, communication, and CPU optimizer bottlenecks.

candidates.title: GoCkpt: Gradient-Assisted Multi-Step overlapped Checkpointing for Efficient LLM Training
candidates.reason: Overlaps checkpoint transfer across multiple training steps and restores consistent checkpoint state on CPU while optimizing GPU-CPU and SSD persistence throughput; relevant to durable training-state I/O.

candidates.title: AutoHete: An Automatic and Efficient Heterogeneous Training System for LLMs
candidates.reason: Automatically co-tunes activation checkpointing, parameter offloading and optimizer offloading across heterogeneous CPU/GPU memory, with priority scheduling to overlap operations across iterations.

discovery_stats.query_summary: Independent training-system axis covering long-context memory reduction, heterogeneous CPU/GPU training, out-of-core optimizers, checkpoint I/O, and automatic offload planning; filtered against canonical monthly identity snapshots.
